note: Micon submodule: adds an Icon (#type micon) picker to the node type form and stores the chosen icon selector as a third-party setting on the node_type config entity: third_party_settings.micon_content_type.icon (e.g. fa-file). No settings form, no configure route. Read via micon_content_type_icon($type) or $type->getThirdPartySetting('micon_content_type','icon'). It also registers content_type.<label>/content_type.<machine_name> micon_icons definitions via hook_micon_icons_alter(). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real third-party setting on a node type.

evals.prompt: With the micon_content_type module, where is a content type's chosen Micon icon stored, and under which third-party settings key?
evals.expected_output: It is stored on the node_type config entity as a third-party setting: third_party_settings.micon_content_type.icon = the icon selector (e.g. fa-file). Read it with micon_content_type_icon($type) or $type->getThirdPartySetting('micon_content_type','icon').

evals.prompt: How do I set the Micon icon fa-file on the Article content type in PHP using the micon_content_type module?
evals.expected_output: Load the node type and set the third-party setting: NodeType::load('article')->setThirdPartySetting('micon_content_type','icon','fa-file')->save() (setThirdPartySetting then save).

evals.prompt: The micon_content_type module lets me reference a content type's icon by a string through Micon's icon-matching system. What string(s) resolve to the Article type's icon?
evals.expected_output: Via hook_micon_icons_alter() it registers content_type.<machine_name> and content_type.<lowercased label>, so micon('content_type.article') resolves to the Article type's icon.

evals.prompt: This site has a content type with machine name micon_ct_med that was given a Micon icon via the micon_content_type module. Inspect the live site and report the icon selector stored for it.
evals.expected_output: The stored icon is fa-flag: node.type.micon_ct_med has third_party_settings.micon_content_type.icon = fa-flag.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a content type with machine name micon_ct_task that currently has no Micon icon. Using the micon_content_type module, set its icon to fa-star and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: node.type.micon_ct_task has third_party_settings.micon_content_type.icon = fa-star (set via setThirdPartySetting('micon_content_type','icon','fa-star') and save, or by picking the icon on the content type edit form).
